notice: Entirely fictional holdout evidence. Names, organizations, publishers, and URLs are test data.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Devices LLC charged over import declarations
evidence.excerpt: A fictional court filing names Blue Gulf Devices LLC itself as the defendant charged over import declarations. The charge is pending; no conviction is reported.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Devices director charged in personal matter
evidence.excerpt: Nora Reed, a director of Blue Gulf Devices LLC, was charged in a personal tax matter. The filing names Reed alone and does not charge the company.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Logistics LLC convicted in import case
evidence.excerpt: Blue Gulf Logistics LLC has a different registration number and no stated ownership link to Blue Gulf Devices LLC. Only Blue Gulf Logistics LLC was convicted.

evidence.title: Brokers fined for trades in Blue Gulf Devices shares
evidence.excerpt: A fictional regulator fined two named brokers for their own trading violations in Blue Gulf Devices LLC shares. The notice does not fine or accuse Blue Gulf Devices LLC.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Devices fined, report says
evidence.excerpt: This secondary headline describes a fictional regulator notice. The notice itself names two brokers as fined for trades in Blue Gulf Devices LLC shares and states no penalty against Blue Gulf Devices LLC.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Devices discloses customer-data exposure
evidence.excerpt: Blue Gulf Devices LLC disclosed that an attacker accessed customer records through its service. The company is the subject of the incident report; no offence by the company is alleged.

evidence.title: Blue Gulf Devices LLC reduces headcount
evidence.excerpt: The company announced routine layoffs after changing product lines. The article reports no misconduct, lawsuit, or regulatory action.

evidence.title: Anonymous post alleges Blue Gulf Devices is a scam
evidence.excerpt: A forum user gives no transaction, document, named complainant, or independent corroboration for the allegation.

evidence.title: Regulator fines Blue Gulf Devices LLC for recordkeeping failures
evidence.excerpt: The fictional regulator notice names Blue Gulf Devices LLC as the penalized party for recordkeeping failures. It does not report a criminal conviction.
